photos.c: winners: southern 4x110 P.Eldridge, S.Deane, R.Holtum, D.Carter.

It's August 1st 1953 and the Club Championships are being held at Battersea Park. Basil Walden (2) takes the 100yds title, equalling the Championship Best of 10.2, with Denis Merrett (1) 2nd in the same time and Ron Holtum (4) 3rd. Basil rejoined the Club this year and of course Dudley Gordon (7) has never ever left us.
